meta.title: British Columbia & Pacific Region Marine Colour Palettes
meta.description: Curated bespoke palettes for BC groundfish, Pacific salmon, pelagics, shellfish, and Pacific Region fisheries sets alongside flagship R colour packages.

palettes.name: Yelloweye Rockfish
palettes.notes: Bright vermilion-orange body, brilliant golden-yellow iris, dusky dorsal spines, and pale lateral line.

palettes.name: China Rockfish
palettes.notes: Blue-black obsidian body slashed by an unmistakable bright chartreuse-yellow lateral stripe and speckled pale blue-white.

palettes.name: Tiger Rockfish
palettes.habitat: Deep rocky crevices & boulder walls (55–300 m)
palettes.notes: Striking bold charcoal-black vertical bars alternating across warm coral-peach and rose flanks.

palettes.name: Canary Rockfish
palettes.notes: Luminous orange-mottled flanks over pale silver-grey with bright tangerine dorsal fins.

palettes.name: Quillback Rockfish
palettes.notes: Deep espresso-brown body with a bright amber-yellow saddle extending onto the deeply incised dorsal fin.

palettes.name: Pacific Ocean Perch
palettes.notes: BC's flagship commercial slope rockfish: deep abyssal crimson grading through carmine red to pale salmon-rose.

palettes.name: Copper Rockfish
palettes.habitat: Inshore rocky reefs & kelp beds (0–180 m)
palettes.notes: Burnished copper-brown dorsum, olive-bronze flanks, and a clean cream-white posterior lateral line.

palettes.name: Shortspine Thornyhead
palettes.notes: Vivid deep-water scarlet and crimson contrasted with dusky charcoal pectoral margins and ivory highlights.

palettes.name: Blue / Deacon Rockfish
palettes.notes: Schooling pelagic indigo and slate-blue dorsum lightening into cerulean flanks and silver mist.

palettes.name: Widow Rockfish
palettes.notes: Dusky bronze-slate back, warm umber flanks, smoky charcoal fin tips, and silvery cream belly.

palettes.name: Bocaccio
palettes.notes: Olive-bronze back shifting to burnt orange-pink flanks with distinctive dark ink spots on juveniles.

palettes.name: Rougheye / Blackspotted
palettes.notes: Long-lived deep slope crimson and dusky rose accented with black-rimmed spiny dorsal tips.

palettes.name: Silvergray Rockfish
palettes.notes: Cool metallic silver-grey flanks, olive-charcoal dorsum, and a subtle blush of pale pink along the ventral fins.

palettes.name: Redbanded Rockfish
palettes.notes: Four bold crimson-red vertical bands alternating across pale porcelain pink and cool silver-grey.

palettes.name: Pacific Halibut
palettes.habitat: Shelf to deep slope sand & gravel (20–1000 m)
palettes.notes: Mottled deep olive-slate eyed side grading through benthic sand and kelp taupe to luminous chalky white.

palettes.name: Arrowtooth Flounder
palettes.notes: Earthy umber and muddy olive grading into soft sandy beige and translucent pale ivory.

palettes.name: Starry Flounder
palettes.notes: Unmistakable bold black-and-ochre-orange striped dorsal and anal fins framing a mottled olive-brown body.

palettes.name: Petrale Sole
palettes.habitat: Shelf sand & winter spawning deeps (50–500 m)
palettes.notes: Warm walnut-brown and muted terracotta tones paired with cool benthic taupe and shell white.

palettes.name: Dover Sole
palettes.notes: Cool deep-slope umber transitioning through smoky dusk-grey and slate-blue to silver mist.

palettes.name: English Sole
palettes.notes: Uniform warm bronze-brown eyed side softening into golden sand and clean pale cream.

palettes.name: Southern Rock Sole
palettes.notes: Camouflaged pebble palette of kelp olive, russet-ochre speckles, slate gravel, and pale shell.

palettes.name: Lingcod
palettes.notes: Mottled kelp-bronze and granite grey punctuated by the iconic biliverdin blue-green turquoise of BC lingcod.

palettes.name: Kelp Greenling
palettes.habitat: Nearshore kelp forests & rocky reefs (0–50 m)
palettes.notes: Sexually dimorphic reef jewel: electric turquoise male spots paired with female burnt copper and kelp gold.

palettes.name: Sablefish
palettes.notes: Sleek abyssal slate-black (blackcod) gliding smoothly through steel blue and pewter to icy silver.

palettes.name: Pacific Cod
palettes.notes: Warm mottled olive-brown dorsum, brassy ochre spots, steel-grey flanks, and crisp white fin edges.

palettes.name: Walleye Pollock
palettes.notes: Speckled olive-slate dorsum fading into cool silvery-blue midwater flanks and bright pearl white.

palettes.name: Pacific Hake
palettes.notes: BC's largest-volume groundfish fishery: midnight pelagic navy to metallic steel-blue and luminous silver.

palettes.name: Spotted Ratfish
palettes.notes: Otherworldly iridescent bronze, metallic emerald-green sheen, deep plum-slate, and bright pearl spots.

palettes.name: Big Skate
palettes.notes: Mottled mud-olive wings marked with large charcoal-and-ochre eyespots and dusty parchment edges.

palettes.name: Longnose Skate
palettes.notes: Deep dusty slate-brown and smoky plum grading into cool muddy grey and soft ventral lilac-grey.

palettes.name: Spiny Dogfish
palettes.habitat: Coastal straits to offshore shelf (0–900 m)
palettes.notes: Clean dorsal storm-slate and cool ocean grey softening smoothly to pale silver and chalk white.

palettes.name: Chinook Salmon
palettes.habitat: NE Pacific pelagic & major BC rivers
palettes.notes: King of Pacific salmon: ocean steel-blue and silver flanks shifting to spawning burnished copper and forest olive.

palettes.name: Sockeye Salmon
palettes.habitat: Offshore Gulf of Alaska & sockeye nursery lakes
palettes.notes: Iconic spawning scarlet-crimson torso paired with vibrant emerald-olive head, river slate, and ocean silver.

palettes.name: Coho Salmon
palettes.notes: Metallic silver-blue ocean phase meeting dark teal-slate dorsum and rich spawning maroon-rose flanks.

palettes.name: Pink Salmon
palettes.notes: Bright silver flanks, olive-slate back with bold oval tail spots, and soft rose-pink spawning blush.

palettes.name: Chum Salmon
palettes.habitat: North Pacific pelagic & lower coastal rivers
palettes.notes: Calico spawning bars of olive-green, plum-purple, and muted crimson over dark river slate and silver.

palettes.name: Steelhead
palettes.notes: Chrome steel-blue sheen and river granite contrasted by a luminous rainbow-rose lateral band.

palettes.name: Pacific Herring
palettes.habitat: Coastal bays, straits & spring kelp spawn
palettes.notes: Keystone BC forage fish: deep ocean navy and pelagic sea-green shifting into iridescent cobalt and bright silver.

palettes.name: Albacore Tuna
palettes.notes: Deep oceanic cobalt dorsum, electric cyan lateral flash, metallic silver belly, and golden finlet accent.

palettes.name: Pacific Sardine
palettes.notes: Iridescent blue-green pelagic back, charcoal lateral spots, cool steel flanks, and bright silver mist.

palettes.name: Eulachon
palettes.notes: Culturally vital candlefish: subtle estuarine slate and blue-grey softening into luminous translucent pearl.

palettes.name: Pacific Mackerel
palettes.notes: Shimmering emerald-teal back laced with dark navy wavy tiger stripes over cool pearl silver.

palettes.name: Northern Anchovy
palettes.notes: Olive-blue dorsum transitioning through bright seafoam cyan into shimmering silver.

palettes.name: Dungeness Crab
palettes.notes: Signature purple-brown carapace, warm cooked-terracotta accent, sandy ochre legs, and pale cream underside.

palettes.name: Spot Prawn
palettes.habitat: Deep rocky fjords & glass sponge reefs (70–300 m)
palettes.notes: BC's prized prawn: deep burgundy-maroon through vivid coral-red and warm tangerine to crisp white abdominal spots.

palettes.name: Pacific Geoduck
palettes.notes: Calm tidal-flat palette of wet umber, coastal slate, warm intertidal sand, and pale chalky shell.

palettes.name: Red Sea Urchin
palettes.notes: Rich deep-burgundy and plum spines warming through crimson and sienna to golden uni roe.

palettes.name: Giant Pacific Octopus
palettes.habitat: Rocky dens from intertidal to 1500 m
palettes.notes: Expressive chromatophore palette of deep plum-ink, rust crimson, burnt ochre, coral blush, and pale sucker ivory.

palettes.name: Pinto Abalone
palettes.notes: Mother-of-pearl iridescence: deep abalone teal, luminous turquoise, nacreous violet, kelp olive, and shell rose.

palettes.name: Ochre Sea Star
palettes.notes: Keystone intertidal morphs: royal sea-star purple and vibrant ochre-orange framed by mussel blue-black and barnacle cream.

palettes.name: Opalescent Nudibranch
palettes.habitat: BC tidepools, docks & kelp forests (0–35 m)
palettes.notes: Cyberpunk tidepool sea slug: neon-cyan opalescent stripes, glowing tangerine cerata tips, hot-magenta accents, acid chartreuse, and midnight reef black.

palettes.name: Pacific Spiny Lumpsucker
palettes.habitat: Cold BC eelgrass & rocky kelp beds (0–150 m)
palettes.notes: Golf-ball-sized suction-cup oddity spanning radioactive lime-chartreuse, bubblegum rose, ultraviolet plum, lemon zest, and electric mint.

palettes.name: Grunt Sculpin
palettes.habitat: Empty giant barnacle shells & rocky reefs (0–165 m)
palettes.notes: Tiny armored barnacle-squatting reef goblin that crawls on its fins: zebra-striped bone & ink black slammed against shocking crimson fins and sulfur yellow.

palettes.name: Blue-Fleshed Lingcod (Biliverdin)
palettes.habitat: NE Pacific rocky reefs (biliverdin pigment anomaly)
palettes.notes: Inspired by BC's surreal turquoise-fleshed lingcod anomaly: radioactive biliverdin cyan-mint colliding with raw crimson-garnet, chartreuse, and abyssal kelp.

palettes.name: Strawberry Anemone Wall
palettes.habitat: Cold dark BC fjord walls & rock overhangs (0–50 m)
palettes.notes: Clonal psychedelic wall of blinding fluorescent hot-pink, electric coral-magenta, golden-tip glow, and translucent white clubbed tentacles.

palettes.name: Abyssal Bioluminescence
palettes.habitat: NE Pacific oxygen minimum zone (600–1200 m)
palettes.notes: Deep bathypelagic photophore palette: void velvet black, ultraviolet violet, piercing sapphire, neon bioluminescent cyan, and crimson cloak.

palettes.name: Fried Egg Jellyfish
palettes.habitat: Salish Sea inlets & NE Pacific surface waters
palettes.notes: Surreal sunny-side-up drifter: glowing egg-yolk yellow & amber bell, translucent milky white, trailing ultraviolet oral arms, and dark fjord teal.

palettes.name: Pacific Hagfish Slime
palettes.habitat: Deep muddy BC basins & slope (15–960 m)
palettes.notes: BC's jawless slime-weaving scavenger: bruised fleshy mauve, raw bubblegum-pink skin, opalescent chartreuse-pearl mucus threads, and abyssal mud.

palettes.name: BC Groundfish Guilds
palettes.notes: Distinctive 6-colour CVD-safe palette for major BC groundfish guilds in gfsynopsis: reef crimson, benthic gold, shelf sky-blue, kelp pine, abyssal slate, and ratfish plum.

palettes.name: BC Rockfish Assemblage
palettes.notes: Warm reef-to-slope Sebastes palette inspired by POP, Yelloweye, China, Tiger, Silvergray, and Blue rockfish.

palettes.name: BC Flatfish Assemblage
palettes.notes: Earthy benthic sand, kelp-olive, walnut, and tidal-slate palette tailored for BC flatfish trawl & survey comparisons.

palettes.name: Pacific Salmon Set
palettes.notes: River-and-ocean salmonid palette: glacier navy Chinook, spawning crimson Sockeye, coastal teal Coho, rose Pink, olive-gold Chum, and chrome Steelhead.

palettes.name: BC Pelagics & Forage Set
palettes.notes: Cool open-ocean palette of abyssal indigo, tuna cobalt, seafoam cyan, silvery pearl, albacore gold, and krill-coral.

palettes.name: BC Shellfish & Marine Set
palettes.notes: Vibrant intertidal & fjord jewel palette inspired by red urchin burgundy, spot prawn coral, ochre sea star, abalone turquoise, geoduck ivory, and octopus plum.

palettes.name: Pacific Region Sectors
palettes.notes: High-level 6-colour palette separating BC Pacific Region fishery sectors cleanly under all CVD profiles.

palettes.name: BC Commercial Fleets & Gears
palettes.notes: 7-colour CVD-safe categorical palette for BC commercial fishing fleets and gear types (groundfish, salmon, pelagic, and trap fisheries).

palettes.name: DFO Pacific Branches
palettes.notes: CVD-safe 6-colour palette for Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) regional branches in cross-branch reports, governance visuals, and briefings.

palettes.name: DFO Pacific Science Divisions
palettes.notes: 6-colour CVD-safe palette for Pacific Science Branch divisions (PBS / IOS) across research programs and CSAS summaries.

palettes.name: DFO Synoptic & HBLL Surveys
palettes.notes: Named CVD-safe palette for standard PBS groundfish research surveys in gfsynopsis and gfplot multi-panel index plots.

palettes.name: BC Coastal Management Areas
palettes.notes: 6-colour CVD-safe regional palette for Pacific Fishery Management Area (PFMA) & coastal zone summaries.

palettes.name: BC Shelf to Abyss Bathymetry
palettes.notes: Monotonically ordered depth ramp from sunlit nearshore kelp shallows through Queen Charlotte Sound shelf to abyssal slope.

palettes.name: Stock Status Reference (PA Zones)
palettes.notes: DFO Precautionary Approach traffic-light ramp from Critical (deep crimson-red) through Cautious (luminous amber-gold) to Healthy (cool emerald-forest green), tuned with distinct lightness and cool-green undertone for stronger CVD legibility.

palettes.name: NE Pacific Ocean Anomaly
palettes.notes: Balanced diverging palette for SST, marine heatwave ('The Blob'), upwelling, and PDO anomalies.

palettes.name: viridis
palettes.notes: Perceptually uniform, colorblind-safe default continuous ramp from viridisLite / viridis.

palettes.name: cividis
palettes.notes: Explicitly optimized for deuteranopia and protanopia; constant perceptual gradient from navy to golden yellow.

palettes.name: mako
palettes.notes: Ocean-themed perceptually uniform sequential ramp (named for the Mako shark) from abyssal purple-black to seafoam.

palettes.name: rocket
palettes.notes: High-contrast warm sequential ramp from charcoal-black through magenta-crimson to pale cream.

palettes.name: plasma
palettes.notes: High-chroma violet-to-yellow scientific sequential palette.

palettes.name: magma
palettes.notes: Dark volcanic black-purple through fiery orange to pale ivory.

palettes.name: batlow
palettes.notes: Fabio Crameri's gold-standard scientific rainbow replacement: perceptually uniform & CVD-safe.

palettes.name: oslo
palettes.notes: Clean, understated monochrome-blue bathymetric ramp from scico.

palettes.name: devon
palettes.notes: Deep slate-indigo transitioning through cool violet-blue to pale mist.

palettes.name: vik
palettes.notes: Perceptually uniform blue-to-rust diverging palette from scico (ideal for anomaly maps).

palettes.name: berlin
palettes.notes: Dark-centered diverging palette from icy sky-blue through obsidian to terracotta-coral.

palettes.name: roma
palettes.notes: Multi-hue scientific diverging ramp from deep rust through cream-yellow to cobalt blue.

palettes.name: lipari
palettes.notes: Modern Crameri sequential ramp transitioning from midnight indigo through rose-terracotta to warm cream.

palettes.name: Okabe-Ito
palettes.notes: The gold-standard 8-colour colorblind-safe categorical palette by Okabe & Ito (2008), available via khroma and base R palette.colors().

palettes.name: Paul Tol Bright
palettes.notes: Paul Tol's bright 7-colour qualitative palette rigorously designed for colorblind clarity.

palettes.name: Paul Tol Muted
palettes.notes: Paul Tol's refined 9-colour muted qualitative scheme ideal for multi-species publication figures.

palettes.name: Paul Tol Sunset
palettes.notes: Paul Tol's crisp blue-cream-crimson diverging scale.

palettes.name: Set2
palettes.notes: Classic soft ColorBrewer qualitative palette widely used in R/ggplot2 ecology papers.

palettes.name: Dark2
palettes.notes: Saturated, print-legible ColorBrewer qualitative palette ideal for line plots and points.

palettes.name: YlGnBu
palettes.notes: Classic oceanography & spatial density sequential ramp from pale yellow through teal to deep navy.

palettes.name: RdBu
palettes.notes: Standard ColorBrewer diverging red-white-blue scale.

palettes.name: BrBG
palettes.notes: Earth-to-ocean brown-white-teal ColorBrewer diverging scale; strongly CVD-safe.

palettes.name: CARTO Safe
palettes.notes: CARTO's 10-colour colorblind-safe qualitative palette for complex thematic maps and charts.

palettes.name: CARTO Bold
palettes.notes: Crisp high-contrast categorical scheme from rcartocolor.

palettes.name: CARTO Temps
palettes.notes: Modern teal-yellow-coral diverging ramp from rcartocolor.

palettes.name: Acanthurus olivaceus
palettes.notes: Orangespot Surgeonfish from nschiett/fishualize: slate-charcoal, vivid tangerine, sky blue, and olive.

palettes.name: Centropyge loricula
palettes.notes: Flame Angelfish from nschiett/fishualize: electric crimson, vermilion-orange, deep cobalt, and obsidian.

palettes.name: Ostracion cubicus
palettes.notes: Yellow Boxfish from nschiett/fishualize: vivid mustard-gold, marine teal, cobalt, and deep ink.

palettes.name: Hypsypops rubicundus
palettes.notes: NE Pacific Garibaldi from nschiett/fishualize: fiery California reef orange contrasted with neon blue.

palettes.name: Oncorhynchus tshawytscha (fishualize)
palettes.notes: Chinook Salmon entry from nschiett/fishualize for direct comparison alongside pacfishpalettes' BC salmon series.

palettes.name: PNW Bay
palettes.notes: Jake Lawlor's PNWColors Bay palette: deep Salish Sea teal through sunlit gold to coastal crimson.

palettes.name: PNW Cascades
palettes.notes: Pacific Northwest alpine & conifer tones from PNWColors.

palettes.name: PNW Sailboat
palettes.notes: Coastal harbour navy, mist blue, golden ochre, and rust sail red from PNWColors.

palettes.name: PNW Starfish
palettes.notes: Pacific Northwest intertidal palette from PNWColors.

palettes.name: PNW Shuksan
palettes.notes: Alpine dawn violet to slate blue and glacier sky from PNWColors.

palettes.name: PNW Sunset
palettes.notes: Coastal Pacific twilight from deep indigo through violet-rose to golden horizon.

palettes.name: Hiroshige
palettes.notes: Colorblind-safe MetBrewer diverging palette inspired by Utagawa Hiroshige woodblock prints.

palettes.name: Hokusai1
palettes.notes: MetBrewer ocean-and-terracotta palette inspired by Katsushika Hokusai.

palettes.name: Isfahan2
palettes.notes: Crisp CVD-safe 5-colour MetBrewer palette of deep teal, turquoise, and warm gold.

palettes.name: Nature (NPG)
palettes.notes: Nature Publishing Group palette from ggsci::scale_color_npg().

palettes.name: JCO
palettes.notes: Journal of Clinical Oncology muted blue-gold-slate palette from ggsci::scale_color_jco().
